# fui palette

Eight editions, each a complete palette named for its one signal colour; three display tiers.
`fui mode toggle` (SUPER+SHIFT+T) cycles cyan → amber → phosphor → acid → hazard → mono → paper → lab; `fui display` picks the tier.
Source of truth: [`tokens.toml`](tokens.toml). Design rules: [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md).

## Type
| Voice | Face |
|---|---|
| brand: the host name, the clock, display numerals | Michroma |
| interface: controls and prose | Inter |
| data: values, codes, labels, terminals | JetBrainsMono Nerd Font |
